TEXT: [FI] I strengthened my resolve to face Kuroneko once more.
[FI] Because I've received encouragement from many people.
[FI] I'll work hard in my own way even if I'm rejected by her again. I've made such a resolve to myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yo. It looks like you haven't made much progress.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What do you want? You sure have a lot of free time if you can come to the freshmen's classroom during summer.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's not because I have spare time. I'm here because I have something to do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Is it something that specifically requires you to be here?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It does.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're... unexpectedly stubborn.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Stubborn? Whatever are you talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm sure you know about it? If you're being so reckless... I'm sure you're about to reach your limit?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Heh, not at all...  I am merely doing what is necessary to accomplish what I want.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] How stubborn.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hehe, this is something that anyone would be able to do if they wanted to.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Doing your best to reach your goal, how is that wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] People don't just work themselves to exhaustion!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Look at you, you're visibly swaying...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, let me help...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Not needed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Tch, at least let me finish what I have to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] My reply will be the same no matter how many times you say it. Why don't you put in some effort to learn that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You're not looking at me from the start.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's useless no matter what you say, I have no intention of listening to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So anything I say is useless?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, that's right. So leave me be.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Please don't stop me any more, it's just a little more so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Isn't it a given that I have to stop you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Do you think I'll allow you to continue being reckless when you are in your current state?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's why I've said, you're a hindrance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] If being worried about you is being a hindrance, then I'll continue to be a hindrance as many times as I want.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'll accept your kind intentions since you've put it this way. I appreciate it. That's why...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Do you understand that everything will be over once you collapse at that moment just for "a little more"?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Of course. However, this time it's just... my ability is still not sufficient.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's a pity to be unable to finish something. I have some regret... But it is my desire to walk this path of sacrifice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...What kind of desire is that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...As expected, it looks like our opinions differ.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Isn't it about time you let me go? This amount of time is very important to me right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But you haven't listened to anything I've said?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's pointless no matter what you say. Don't you understand? Both of us have no intention of giving way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Of course, I'm here just to stop you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Really? However, I won't give in, no matter what you say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So please stop wasting time. The time I allocated to you is hereby over.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...What's the meaning of that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It means exactly what I just said. At the very least, we shouldn't meet until... after the manuscript is done.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You'll only cause me trouble when you look for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You mean... you won't even come to school?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes. Work can be done at home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Are you an idiot!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] To go that far to avoid me... and I can't even care about you, is that what you're saying?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...It's as you have said. Having that intention is enough.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So, please don't interfere unnecessarily.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...What if I were to say no? If I say I'm not going to allow this and even forcefully stopping you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's just repeating what we've said today. It's unproductive. It's useless, give it up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll keep stopping you until you do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I won't stop. ...No, I'll give it my all to compensate for lost time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Tch... That's unfair... How am I supposed to respond to what you've said...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You don't have to. I've said this before, haven't I?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] There's only one thing I want you to do right now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...And that would be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...You ignoring me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That again...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] How about it? If you're really worried about me, can you do me this small favor?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What do you mean by ignoring you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's simple. Don't talk to me even if we meet, it'll be just like we don't know each other. Treating me as a complete stranger will do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Just like a complete stranger, how is that even possible...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm too worried about you, why is it that you can't understand?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Senpai, just give up on me now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What, hey!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is that... your true wish?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, that's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're totally.... okay with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Obviously. I myself am wishing for it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Damn... Is there no way I can stop you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Obviously. I would not be stopped by you. Well, that's that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So, it shall end here. I'll say it one last time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Leave me alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Until when?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Let's see... until after the manuscript is done.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] At least, we'll have to meet after school starts, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So, before the manuscript is completed, we are complete strangers. Don't talk to me even if we meet, all right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'm sure you can bear with it if it's this kind of level, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ....Are you serious?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Even if it's just like you said....when that ends, we can return to our old relationship? Are you going to... go back to before?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] The relations of people are something that continuously change, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That is why I shall now bid farewell to you.
[FI] Damn... Isn't there anything I can say...
[FI] To see her walk off, unable to do anything, it's frustrating... Do I just stand here gritting my teeth...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...ah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah! Hey! Kuroneko, Kuroneko!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Damn it! T-To the infirmary!
